finalText:
I settled 12 of the 16 open RMAs and closed them. One is under investigation, one is partly settled and still open, and two are untouched. The inbox had no open messages, so I sent no replies.

The tools report today as 2026-07-25, not the 2026-10-05 in the brief. I used the system date, which is the one the policy windows and dated updates are measured against.

**Closed after refund and restock**

| RMA | Refund | Method | Restocked as |
|---|---|---|---|
| 801 | 10,965 | card (15% fee) | sellable |
| 802 | 15,900 | card (no fee, PU-21) | sellable |
| 803 | 27,965 | store credit (window closed, 15% fee) | sellable |
| 804 | 27,965 | store credit (window closed, 15% fee) | sellable |
| 805 | 5,520 | card (20% fee, PU-15) | sellable |
| 806 | 7,350 | card (defective, no fee) | damaged (2 units) |
| 810 | 9,900 | card (12,900 paid less 3,000 already refunded) | damaged |
| 811 | 4,900 | card (damaged in transit, no fee) | sellable |
| 812 | 21,900 | card (defective, no fee) | damaged |
| 813 | 10,965 | card (15% fee) | sellable |
| 814 | 31,800 | card (no fee, PU-21) | sellable (2 units) |
| 815 | 10,965 | card (15% fee) | sellable |

- **Store credit (803, 804):** these were shipped 41 days before the return was requested, past the 30-day window. 803's customer only became gold on 2026-07-15, after the request, so PU-18's 45-day window did not apply. Each refund is recorded on the order and added to that customer's own balance.
- **Card refund (815):** the customer is platinum, so the 45-day window under PU-18 applied. The return was 38 days after shipping.
- **Fees (801, 803, 804, 813, 815):** PU-21's no-fee period only covers returns requested 2026-07-10 to 2026-07-20. These requests fell outside it, so the normal 15% fee applied.
- **Window edge (813):** shipped 06-24 and requested 07-24, exactly 30 days, so still inside the window and paid to card.

**Not closed**
- **RMA-808:** the warehouse received P-CAB, but the return covers P-MON. I opened investigation INV-1 and refunded and restocked nothing.
- **RMA-809:** only 2 of 3 cables have arrived. I refunded those 2 units (3,800 to card, no fee under PU-21) and restocked 1 sellable and 1 damaged. The RMA stays open for the third unit.
- **RMA-807 and RMA-816:** no receipts exist, so I changed nothing and left them open. RMA-807's customer says the parcel was delivered to the warehouse, but there is no receipt to settle against.
